meta.scope: chromium/src branch main: merged, abandoned and open CLs; bot-owned CLs excluded from review metrics (counted in weekly_totals.csv)
meta.weeks_rule: comments, chars, AI and post-merge comments count in the week the comment was written; vote-only reviews in the week of the vote; reviewed_cls in the week the CL closed; reviewers = accounts credited with any of these that week; weekly_totals is by close week
meta.org_rule: affiliations.json5 (dated, as of the day of the activity) > other @chromium.org -> google.com > email domain
meta.metric_notes: reviews = non-owner, non-bot accounts that voted Code-Review or wrote a comment; a vote on a CL with no counted comment by the voter counts as one comment (reported as vote_only_reviews); comments exclude self-declared AI (is_ai flag or autogenerated:* tag; reported separately as ai_comments, a lower bound) and include post-merge comments (written after the CL closed; that subset is also reported as post_merge_comments); chars exclude quoted '>' lines
